decisions.notebook: Ironwood runs Intimidate cycling (Incineroar), Drought Torkoal, Mega Metagross, Trick Room Hatterene. Key facts: Torkoal (36-64 spe) is slower than Hippowdon (67), so its Drought overrides Sand Stream on a simultaneous lead — plan for sun turn 1 vs Torkoal. Hatterene has Magic Bounce: NEVER Yawn it; answer with Excadrill Iron Head (Steel SE vs Fairy, Excadrill faster even without sand) or double Rock Slide flinches. Excadrill at 220 sand-speed outspeeds max-speed Meowscarada (192) and Mamoswine (132); Iron Head threatens Meowscarada, EQ threatens Mamoswine/Metagross. Metagross's Steel STABs are resisted by Excadrill; Hippowdon tanks Meteor Mash (~43% max) and EQs back SE. Sand chip breaks Mamoswine's Focus Sash for Blaziken CC. Mega Blaziken: Protect turn 1 to bank Speed Boost (~195 at +1), then CC Incineroar/Mamoswine, Flare Blitz Metagross. Passimian Defiant punishes Intimidate, walls Meowscarada, Payapa tanks Metagross coverage. Series plan: sand core (Hippo+Excadrill) with Blaziken endgame; keep Gengar in reserve if Hatterene/TR proves decisive in later games.

decisions.rationale: Lead Incineroar + Torkoal to immediately establish Drought sun. Incineroar Fake Out disrupts opponent's turn 1 while Torkoal fires sun-boosted Eruption. Intimidate weakens physical threats like Excadrill and Gyarados. Metagross-Mega and Meowscarada in back handle Blaziken-Mega and Gengar respectively. This sun mode pressures their entire physical-heavy roster before they can set up sand or Dragon Dance.
decisions.notebook: Opponent runs physical-heavy team with two Intimidate users (Gyarados, Hippowdon indirectly via Excadrill synergy). Sand + Excadrill is their primary speed control mode. Blaziken-Mega Speed Boost makes it increasingly dangerous each turn. My sun mode hard counters their Water/Flying Gyarados and weakens their Fire-type Blaziken. Metagross-Mega Clear Body ignores all Intimidate drops, crucial against their Intimidate-reliant strategy. Meowscarada Flower Trick never misses, bypassing accuracy drops. Plan: establish sun early, use Incineroar Intimidate cycling to manage physical threats, Mega Metagross to handle Blaziken-Mega and Excadrill, Meowscarada for Gengar and Whimsicott if present. Trick Room mode with Hatterene is backup if sun fails.

decisions.rationale: Sun Eruption is a guaranteed OHKO on Excadrill and Fake Out is incoming, so Excadrill Protects turn 1. Hippowdon tanks Eruption (38-69%) fine and Yawn on Torkoal (Mental Herb doesn't cure drowsiness) forces it to sleep end of next turn or switch, defusing the Eruption threat while preserving both my mons. Turn 2: Excadrill Rock Slide/EQ with Hippowdon as Torkoal sleeps.

decisions.notebook: Tough Claws 1.3x on contact moves is essential for Metagross damage calcs—estimate_damage tool ignores abilities, so multiply by 1.3x manually. SandStream only triggers on switch-in; current weather is none. Excadrill LO+SandRush becomes devastating if sand activates—prioritize eliminating or preventing sand. Yawn sleep triggers end of turn after use; sleep lasts 1-3 turns with wake check each turn. Preserve HP when ahead; 1v2 from low HP is nearly unwinnable. Opponent backline threats: Gyarados (Sitrus/Intimidate), Gengar (Colbur/CursedBody), Passimian (Payapa/Defiant).

decisions.rationale: Metagross is the last opposing mon at 4% and asleep. Both attackers target it: Knock Off is 2x SE and Iron Head easily KOs at 4% even resisted. Metagross is asleep at 5% HP—likely our last mon. If it wakes, Meteor Mash on Passimian (27.1-58.9% base ×1.3 Tough Claws ×1.5 +1Atk = 52.8-114.9%) is the only KO chance. Excadrill target is NVE and won't KO. Priority irrelevant since Mega outspeeds both. Must try to trade 1-for-1.

reflections.summary: The team-preview plan was fundamentally mismatched: the Incineroar/Torkoal/Metagross/Meowscarada core and Mega Metagross lack Ground immunities, Taunt, and sleep protection, making them structurally vulnerable to Hippowdon’s Sand Stream + Yawn and Excadrill’s Sand Rush. The loss resulted from this draft flaw, not piloting, as sand activation and Yawn locked Mega Metagross out while Excadrill swept.
reflections.adjustment: Replace Mega Metagross with a Ground-immune or Water-type pivot (e.g., Mega Gyarados) and lead with a faster Taunt/Encore user to block Yawn and Speed Boost, directly neutralizing the sand core before it activates.
reflections.notebook: Opponent leads Hippowdon/Excadrill to instantly activate Sand Stream; Hippowdon uses Yawn/Protect to stall and disrupt. Excadrill runs Life Orb Sand Rush, prioritizing Earthquake. Passimian holds Payapa Berry with Defiant, punishing Intimidate and stat drops. Mega Blaziken relies on Speed Boost + Close Combat. Backline Gyarados (Intimidate/Sitrus) and Gengar (Cursed Body/Colbur) indicate physical disruption and special bulk preferences. Future games: lead with Taunt/Encore to block Yawn/Speed Boost. Bring Ground-immune/Water-type pivot to check Excadrill in sand. Avoid Mega Metagross vs Hippowdon due to sleep vulnerability and 4x Ground weakness. Target Hippowdon early to prevent sand/Yawn setup.
